
## 2024-05-18 - JSON inside SVG CDATA XSS breakout
**Vulnerability:** XSS breakout possible when pasting SVGs generated by the app, due to JSON in CDATA block containing user input (`]]>`).
**Learning:** `JSON.stringify` does not encode `]]>`, meaning standard JSON encoding of user input can still act as a breakout in XML CDATA blocks.
**Prevention:** Explicitly encode `]]>` in JSON strings embedded in CDATA as `\u005D\u005D\u003E` because `JSON.parse` will decode that correctly.

## 2024-05-18 - PostgREST filter injection and LIKE wildcard abuse
**Vulnerability:** A search input `a.b,c%d_e` could abuse `.ilike()` wildcard execution times (DoS) and alter the logic of `.or()` filters by injecting PostgREST URL operators since those parameters are parsed back to string format for REST calls under the hood by Supabase JS client.
**Learning:** Supabase JS `.or()` builds raw query strings, allowing `,` (OR split) and `.` (operator split) to be injected if user input is interpolated into it.
**Prevention:** Always strip filter characters `,` and `.` as well as wildcard characters `%` and `_` from unescaped user inputs that go into `.or()` strings or `.ilike()`.
